I1.quote: Hydrogen uptake measurements were performed using high-purity hydrogen (99.9999%) at −196 °C (under a liquid nitrogen bath) over the pressure range of 0–20 bar with an intelligent gravimetric analyzer (Hiden, IGA-003).

I2.quote: Two sets of activated samples derived from ZIF templated carbons and prepared via liquid impregnation (LI) or a combination of LI and chemical vapour deposition (CVD) were studied.

I5.quote: The mechanical stability of activated ZIF-templated carbon materials, prepared via liquid impregnation and chemical vapour deposition (CVD) methods, was investigated by compaction at various pressures (compaction loads of 5 and 10 tonnes equivalent to 370 and 740 MPa, respectively).

notes: Gravimetric H2 isotherms (Hiden IGA-003, buoyancy-corrected) at −196 °C, 0–20 bar, Fig. 5; 20 bar values in Table 2 for 12 KOH-activated ZIF-templated carbons (ZIF-8 template carbonized/CVD then KOH-activated and HCl-washed).
